name: KRAFTON/Raon-1-mini-preview config.json
notes: Fetched 2026-10-22. config.json (raw/main) for KRAFTON/Raon-1-mini-preview. model_type raon1_mini, 25 layers, hidden 2,560, 40 attention heads, head_dim 128, num_experts 128 with num_experts_per_token 6 (note the key is num_experts_per_TOKEN here, not num_experts_per_tok), num_shared_experts 1, moe_intermediate_size 1,088, first_k_dense_replace 1, vocab 259,840, max_position_embeddings 262,144, rope_parameters null, hidden_act situ with activation_situ_beta 4.0 / linear_beta 25.0. MLA geometry: q_lora_rank 576, kv_lora_rank 512, qk_nope_head_dim 128, qk_rope_head_dim 64, v_head_dim 128, mla_use_nope true. rda_config lists mla_layers [4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 25] and 18 rda_layers, which is where the 7-layer KV cache comes from: 7 x (512 + 64) x 2 = 8,064 B/token, matching the card's 'about 8 KiB'. quantization_config quant_method mxfp8 with weight_block_size [1, 32] and lm_head / attention / MLP / MoE projections in ignored_layers, so the shipped checkpoint is 8-bit while the safetensors breakdown (BF16 3.11e9 + F8_E4M3 25.67e9) is not a BF16 release. transformers_version 5.16.1, custom_code, so it needs trust_remote_code.
